summary: Quest-ready alerts, optional automatic accept and turn-in, and quest experience totals.
description: Forever Quests plays a sound and prints a message when a quest becomes ready to turn in or an objective is finished. It can accept and turn in quests for you (both off by default; hold Shift to skip it once), and it never picks a reward when a quest offers a choice. It also counts the quests, experience and money you earn from turn-ins. Type /fq for commands.
